docs.text:
Hobbes on the state of nature, the covenant and the sovereign power that keeps the peace.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Thomas Hobbes (1588–1679), Leviathan (1651). This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution.
